# CONFIGS.md — the CONFIGURATION-SURFACE TABLE

The mirror of `ERRORS.md` for **valid** inputs. Bugs hide in the *interaction* of
options and data shapes, not in calling one function once with one value, so this
table enumerates the axes the C actually branches on and their meaningful
combinations:

* every runtime option/mode/flag the public API can set, and the state it toggles
  (derived from the `if`/`switch`/`#ifdef` branches the C takes on those flags);
* every distinct input **shape** the code special-cases (sizes, element counts,
  alphabet widths, formats, byte order, empty / one / many, boundary values);
* the **full** set of public entry points, including the lowest-level ones — not
  just the convenience/one-shot wrappers, because a bug in the composed pipeline
  is invisible to per-wrapper tests.

Each row is checked off only once its differential test passes across *randomized*
inputs (fixed seed), not a single hand-picked value.

## Column meanings

| column | meaning |
|---|---|
| `entry point(s)` | the exported symbols the row exercises |
| `configuration` | the concrete option values *and* the input shape/size set |
| `why the C treats this differently` | the C function/branch the row targets |
| `[x]` | checked when the row passes C-vs-Rust byte-for-byte over its randomized inputs |

## Build configuration

`ZSTD_LEGACY_SUPPORT=5`, `XXH_NAMESPACE=ZSTD_`, `DYNAMIC_BMI2=0`, no
`ZSTD_MULTITHREAD`, no `-mavx2`/`-mbmi2`, `DEBUGLEVEL=0`, `-O0`. `ZSTD_ARCH_X86_SSE2`
*is* defined (so `zstd_lazy.c`'s `ZSTD_row_getSSEMask` is live) while
`ZSTD_ARCH_X86_AVX2` is not. There is exactly **one** Cargo feature combination
(`Cargo.toml` declares no `[features]` section), so this table applies in full to
the single configuration the crate builds.

## Row counts

| area | rows |
|---|---|
| Stable API (`zstd.h`, outside `ZSTD_STATIC_LINKING_ONLY`) | 101 |
| Experimental / static-linking-only API, and the lowest-level exports (FSE, HUF, HIST, xxhash, POOL, divsufsort) | 222 |
| Dictionary builder (`zdict.h`), deprecated `ZBUFF_*`, and the legacy `ZSTDv0x_*` decoders | 110 |
| **total** | **433** |
